data.title: Pakistan Condemns Houthi Attack on King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh
data.content:
Islamabad, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Islamic Republic of Pakistan has strongly condemned the attack launched by the Houthi militia on the King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, reaffirming its full solidarity with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in the face of assaults targeting its security and sovereignty.
    In a statement issued today, the Pakistani Foreign Ministry described this act of aggression as a grave violation of the Kingdom's sovereignty, emphasizing that the persistent targeting of civilian infrastructure and economic facilities endangers innocent lives and poses a serious threat to regional peace and security, while calling for an immediate cessation of such attacks.
    Pakistan reiterated its firm support for the government and people of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as well as its backing for the Kingdom's legitimate right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, and the protection of its citizens and residents.
    The ministry further affirmed Pakistan's continued efforts toward achieving lasting peace and stability in the region.
    -- SPA
